# `gameplay/progression/DomainGraph.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/progression/DomainGraph.js`

DomainGraph — Local rule overrides. A domain is a personal law forced onto an area. Domains are rare and earned. They modify rules within a radius, cost stamina/resolve to maintain, and have weaknesses and failure conditions. Domain rules are priority 8 in RuleGraph — they can override local reality but not engine safety or physics.
